answer.summary: The one failing test asserts that every className in the library resolves to a stylesheet class. Three classes used in RuntimeSettingsForm.tsx (outline-2, outline-offset-2, outline-current) resolve to nothing. This is a deterministic assertion, not a timing or infrastructure problem, so a rerun should fail the same way. The change touched only i18n-loanwords.json, so the log does not show how it caused this. The MissingTranslationError lines are console noise from passing tests and are not the failure.
